- The warning added in `ClientConfiguration.java` complements the changes in `Shell.java` by informing users when the client configuration is not found, which is relevant to the overall configuration management.

- The updates in the test files (`ShellSetInstanceTest.java` and `ShellConfigTest.java`) validate the correctness of the new logic implemented in `Shell.java` and `ShellOptionsJC.java`, ensuring that the changes work as intended and maintain expected behavior.
